skills.description: A specialized skill for generating CCER (Chinese Certified Emission Reduction) Project Design Documents for afforestation/forestry carbon sink projects under methodology CCER-14-001-V01. This skill is built on a real approved case (Hongyuan County protection forest project, 890.63 ha, 40-year crediting period) and incorporates 7 corrective actions + 1 observation from a real CCSC validation. It guides users through carbon layer division, biomass calculations (using Appendix A equations), soil organic carbon changes, dead organic matter, sample plot design, monitoring plan, and uniqueness declaration generation.
